title: Tri-C
protocol: Pre-cool centrifuge to 4°C.
Chill glycine, PBS, and lysis buffer.
Collect cells from tissue and make single-cell suspensions of 1-2 x 10^7 cells in 10 ml growth media.
Add 540 μl 37% formaldehyde (2% final concentration), mix well and incubate for 10 min at RT on a rocking or tumbling incubator.
Quench by adding 1.5 ml 1 M cold glycine (1/8 of the final volume i.e., 12 ml).
Centrifuge 5 min / 1,000 rpm / 4°C.
Wash pellet by gently re-suspending in 10 ml cold PBS.
Centrifuge 5 min / 1,000 rpm / 4°C.
Re-suspend pellet in 5 ml cold lysis buffer.
Incubate for 20 min on ice.
Centrifuge 5 min / 1,800 rpm / 4°C.
Re-suspend pellet in 1 ml lysis buffer and transfer to 1.5 ml microtube.
Snap freeze with ethanol and dry ice or liquid nitrogen.
Store at -80°C.
Pre-warm thermomixer to 37°C.
Defrost aliquots of formaldehyde fixed cells for each reaction.
Centrifuge samples for 5 min at 14,000 rpm at room temperature (RT).
Carefully remove all lysis buffer using a P20 pipette.
Resuspend pellet in 1 ml 1x restriction enzyme buffer.
Homogenize on ice with a Dounce homogenizer (~50 strokes total).
Remove the liquid from the homogenizer and place it in a fresh 1.5 ml microtube.
Add another 400 µl of 1x restriction enzyme buffer to the homogenizer, perform a few more strokes, and add this to the other homogenized material.
Centrifuge samples for 5 min at 14,000 rpm at RT.
Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet in 650 µl of restriction enzyme buffer.
Set up 3 digestion reactions using 200 µl of suspended cells for each reaction and a control without restriction enzyme with the remaining 50 µl.
Shake horizontally for 1 hour at 1,400 rpm at 37°C using the thermomixer.
If cells have clumped, use a wide bore P200 pipette to resuspend them.
Add 66 µl of 20% Triton X 100 to each digestion reaction.
Shake the mixture for 1 hour at 1,400 rpm and 37°C.
Add 10 μl DpnII (500 U) or 20 μl NlaIII (200 U) to each digestion reaction.
Shake until the end of the day at 1,400 rpm and 37°C.
Add another 10 μl DpnII (500 U) or 20 μl NlaIII (200 U).
Shake overnight at 1,400 rpm and 37°C.
Next morning, add another 10 μl DpnII (500 U) or 20 μl NlaIII (200 U).
Shake for a few more hours at 1,400 rpm and 37°C.
Remove 100 μl from each digestion reaction to make Control 2.
Add 3 μl Proteinase K to Control 1 and Control 2.
Incubate on the 65°C hot block overnight.
Place the digestion reactions on a 65°C block for 20 minutes.
Pre-cool the thermomixer to 16°C.
Cool the digestion reactions on ice.
Add 500 μl PCR grade water and 134 μl ligation buffer (x10) to each digestion reaction.
Add 8 μl ligase to each reaction.
Shake overnight at 1,400 rpm and 16°C.
Store controls in the fridge overnight.
Add 5 μl Proteinase K to each digest.
Put on a 65°C hot block overnight.
Add 10 µl of RNAse to each ligation reaction.
Add 4 µl of RNAse to Control 1.
Add 6 µl of RNAse to Control 2.
Incubate the reactions for 30 min at 37°C.
Pool all ligation reactions in a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Add an equal volume of phenol-chloroform-isoamylalcohol (PCI) and shake well.
Centrifuge the ligation reaction for 10 min at 3,000 rpm at room temperature.
Transfer the upper layer to a new tube, avoiding the interface and PCI.
Centrifuge controls for 5 min at 14,000 rpm at room temperature.
Transfer the upper layer of controls to a new microtube, avoiding the interface and PCI.
Add an equal volume of chloroform to both ligation reactions and shake well.
Centrifuge the ligation reaction for 10 min at 3,000 rpm at room temperature.
Centrifuge controls for 5 min at 14,000 rpm at room temperature.
Transfer the upper layer of ligation reactions to a new tube, avoiding the interface and chloroform.
Add precipitation reagents and mix well by inverting.
Freeze the mixture at -80°C or -20°C for at least 2 hours.
Pre-cool the centrifuge to 4°C during incubation.
Centrifuge ligation reaction for 45 min / 2,200 g / 4°C.
Centrifuge controls for 30 min / 14,000 g / 4°C.
Re-suspend all pellets in 1 ml 70% ethanol and transfer the ligation reaction to a microtube.
Centrifuge ligation reactions and controls 10 min / 14,000 g / 4°C.
Remove ethanol from ligation reactions and controls.
Repeat ethanol wash.
Spin in microfuge and use P20 pipette to remove residual ethanol.
Dry pellet at room temperature.
Re-suspend pellet in PCR grade water.
Prepare 5-6 μg of 3C library in a total volume of 120 µl in a Covaris microtube.
Avoid making bubbles when preparing the 3C library in the Covaris microtube.
Shear DNA to 400-500 bp using the Covaris system with these settings: duty cycle 10%, intensity 4, cycles per burst 200, time 55 seconds, and set mode frequency sweeping.
Transfer reaction from Covaris microtube to lowBind DNA 1.5 ml microtube after sonication.
Add 84 μl Ampure XP SPRI beads to the transferred reaction mixture.
Pipette up and down 10 times, allowing the mixture to bind at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on a Dynamag device and discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without disturbing the beads by running it down the front of the tube.
Allow the mixture to sit on the Dynamag for 30 seconds, then remove the ethanol.
Add another 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol, allow to sit for 30 sec at RT and remove all the ethanol.
Spin down on microfuge and replace on Dynamag. Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature on stand until matt in appearance. Be careful not to over dry the beads as this will result in increased DNA losses.
Remove from Dynamag and re-suspend beads in 88 μl PCR grade water. Mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 min to elute.
Replace on Dynamag. Once clear, recover 86 µl in a PCR tube.
Mix 85 µl sonicated 3C library, 10 µl ER Reaction Buffer (green), and 5 µl ER Enzyme Mix in PCR tube and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 20°C for 30 minutes in thermocycler.
Transfer reaction to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 180 μl beads, pipette up and down 10 times, allow to bind at RT for 5 min.
Place on Dynamag, discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from Dynamag. Avoid disturbing beads by running the ethanol down the front of tube.
Allow to sit on Dynamag for 30 sec at RT, then remove ethanol.
Add another 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol and allow to sit for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Remove all the ethanol.
Spin down on microfuge and replace on Dynamag.
Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette carefully.
Air dry at room temperature until matt in appearance.
Resuspend beads in 44 μl PCR grade water by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes to elute.
Replace on Dynamag and recover 42 µl in a PCR tube once clear.
Combine 42 µl End Repaired DNA, 5 µl dA Reaction Buffer, and 3 µl Klenow in a PCR tube by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 37ºC for 30 minutes in thermocycler.
Transfer reaction to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 90 μl beads, pipette up and down 10 times, allow to bind at room temperature for 5 min.
Place on Dynamag and discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without disturbing the beads; let sit on Dynamag for 30 seconds at room temperature, then remove ethanol.
Spin down on microfuge and replace on Dynamag.
Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature on stand until matt in appearance.
Re-suspend beads in 27 μl PCR grade water.
Mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 min to elute.
Replace on Dynamag. Once clear, recover 25 µl in a PCR tube.
Combine 25 µl dA-Tailed DNA, 10 µl Quick Ligation Buffer (red), 10 µl Adaptor (red), and 5 µl T4 DNA Ligase (red) in a PCR tube and mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at 20ºC for 15 minutes in thermocycler.
Add 3 µl USER Enzyme Mix and pipette up and down 10 times.
Incubate at 37ºC for 15 minutes in thermocycler.
Transfer reaction to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 95 μl beads, pipette up and down 10 times, allow to bind at RT for 5 min.
Place on Dynamag, discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from Dynamag.
Allow to sit on Dynamag for 30 sec at RT, then remove ethanol.
Add another 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol, allow to sit for 30 sec at RT and remove all the ethanol.
Spin down the sample on a microfuge and replace it on a Dynamag.
Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature until the appearance is matt. Be careful not to over-dry the beads as this can increase DNA losses.
Resuspend the beads in 53 μl of PCR grade water by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes to elute.
Replace on Dynamag and recover once clear, obtaining 51 µl.
Keep 1 µl to run on TapeStation together with the amplified material.
Transfer the reaction to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 90 μl of Ampure XP SPRI beads, pipette up and down 10 times.
Allow the mixture to bind at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the sample on Dynamag and discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from the Dynamag. Avoid disturbing the beads by running the ethanol down the front of the tube.
Allow the sample to sit on Dynamag for 30 seconds at room temperature, then remove ethanol.
Add another 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol, allow to sit for 30 seconds at room temperature and remove all the ethanol.
Spin down the sample in a microfuge and replace on Dynamag. Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette without removing any beads.
Air dry the sample at room temperature until it appears matte.
Re-suspend beads in 53 μl PCR grade water by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes to elute DNA from beads.
Replace on Dynamag. Once clear, recover 51 µl into a PCR tube.
Run 1 µl of the sample on TapeStation with material pre-amplification for comparison.
Repeat PCR and bead clean-up with remaining 25 μl of adaptor ligated sample.
Pool duplicate PCR reactions.
Quantify library using Qubit dsDNA BR assay kit.
Reconstitute individual or pools of oligonucleotides to a stock concentration of 2.9 µM.
Generate pools of oligonucleotides by mixing in exact 1:1 stoichiometric ratio.
Make working solution of oligonucleotides by diluting pools so that each individual oligonucleotide is at 2.9 nM.
Spin down Nimblegen oligo tubes in a minifuge.
Add 120 μl PCR grade water to the HE Universal Oligo tube; vortex and spin briefly.
Add 10 μl PCR grade water to the HE Index Oligo tube; vortex and spin briefly.
Add 480 μl PCR grade water to the Post-LM-PCR Oligos; vortex and spin briefly.
Mix 1-2 μg of differentially indexed samples at exactly 1:1 ratios by mass.
Heat vacuum centrifuge to 50°C.
Prepare hybridization reaction for the number of pooled libraries – up to 6 libraries are captured in a single tube. For more libraries, prepare a master mix and divide into multiple tubes.
Add 5 μg COT DNA (5 μl of stock) per library.
Add 1 nmol TS-HE Universal Oligo (1 μl of 1 mM stock aliquot) per library.
Add 1 nmol of TS-HE Index Oligos (1 μl of 1 mM stock for each index) per library.
Add 1-2 μg of each uniquely indexed 3C library in a 1:1 ratio by mass.
Vacuum centrifuge at 50°C with tube lids open until sample is completely dry. Avoid drying for a long time after liquid is gone.
For each library, add 7.5 μl 2x Hybridization Buffer (vial 5).
For each library, add 3 μl Hybridization Component A (vial 6).
Carefully reconstitute the DNA by pipetting and vortexing followed by briefly spinning down.
Replace buffers and blocking oligonucleotides in freezer prior to proceeding.
Pre-warm a thermomixer to 95°C.
Pre-warm a thermocycler to 47°C, with lid heated to 57°C.
Heat 4.5 μl per library of pooled biotinylated oligonucleotide probes to 47°C in a PCR tube.
Denature the 3C library mix by heating to 95°C for 10 min on the thermomixer.
Spin the denatured library briefly in a minifuge and replace it on the thermomixer.
Add the entire 3C library mix (10.5 µl per library) to the biotinylated oligonucleotide capture probes without removing them from the thermocycler.
Mix the contents briefly and spin before replacing the tube in the 47°C thermocycler for 64-72h.
Dilute the Stringent Wash Buffer at 47°C on the thermomixer as required.
Place 100 μl of Wash Buffer I per captured library, plus an additional 20 μl to account for evaporation, at 47°C on the thermomixer.
Allow streptavidin beads to heat to RT for 30 min prior to use.
Aliquot 100 μl of streptavidin beads per captured library into a single 1.5 ml microtube.
Place on DynaMag and remove liquid once clear.
Add 200 μl of 1x Bead Wash Buffer per captured library, vortex to resuspend the beads, spin briefly.
Replace on DynaMag for 5 minutes and remove liquid once clear.
Repeat wash steps (d-e) for a total of two washes.
Resuspend the beads in their original volume with Bead Wash Buffer and aliquot into appropriate number of 1.5 ml Sorensen tubes.
Place in the DynaMag, remove and discard the liquid only when ready to add the capture sample from the thermocycler.
Transfer hybridization reactions to streptavidin beads and mix thoroughly by pipetting 10 times.
Spin briefly if necessary to pool all of the sample in the bottom of the tube.
Place on thermomixer at 47°C at 600 rpm for 45 min, mix the beads with a pipette every 15 minutes.
Add 100 μl of heated (47°C) Wash Buffer I per captured library to the beads and bound DNA.
Mix by vortexing.
Place in the Dynamag, carefully discard all the supernatant when clear.
Remove from Dynamag, add 200 μl heated (47°C) Stringent Wash buffer per captured library and mix.
Incubate for 5 mins at 47°C.
Place the tubes in the DynaMag, carefully discard the supernatant when clear.
Repeat stringent wash (d-f) for a total of 2 washes.
Remove from Dynamag, add 200 μl Wash Buffer I (x1) at RT per captured library and mix by vortexing for 2 minutes. Spin briefly to ensure no sample is lost in the lid.
Place the tubes in the DynaMag, carefully discard the supernatant when clear.
Remove from Dynamag, add 200 μl Wash Buffer II (x1) per captured library and mix by vortexing for 1 minute. Spin briefly to ensure no sample is lost in the lid.
Place the tubes in the DynaMag, carefully discard the supernatant when clear.
Remove from Dynamag, add 200 μl Wash Buffer III (x1) and mix by vortexing for 30 seconds. Spin briefly to ensure no sample is lost in the lid.
Place the tubes in the DynaMag, carefully discard the supernatant when clear.
Remove from DynaMag and resuspend beads in 40 μl PCR grade water per capture library.
Amplify the captured fragments in two separate reactions per captured library.
Transfer reaction to a 1.5 ml microtube.
Add 90 μl beads per reaction, pipette up and down 10 times, allow to bind at RT for 5 min.
Place on Dynamag, discard liquid when clear.
Add 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol without removing from Dynamag. Allow to sit on Dynamag for 30 sec at RT, then remove ethanol.
Add another 500 μl of fresh 80% ethanol, allow to sit for 30 sec at RT and remove all the ethanol.
Spin down on microfuge and replace on Dynamag. Remove residual ethanol with a P10 pipette, taking care not to remove any beads.
Air dry at room temperature on stand until matt in appearance.
Remove from Dynamag and re-suspend beads in 53 μl PCR grade water.
Mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate at RT for 2 min to elute.
Replace on Dynamag. Once clear, recover 51 μl in a PCR tube.
Run 1 μl in TapeStation to confirm same profile as input material.
Repeat amplification on the remainder of the beads.
Pool amplifications.
Quantify with Qubit BR Kit.
Pool amplified material of the parallel PCR reactions.

Prepare the second capture hybridization reaction using all captured material in a single reaction. Combine 5 μg COT DNA, 1 nmol TS-HE Universal Oligo, and 1 nmol of TS-HE Index Oligos with up to 2 μg of amplified captured material.
Perform hybridization, washes, and amplification as described with a 24-hour hybridization at 47°C and treating the material as a single library.
Use the KAPA Library Quantification Kit to calculate the concentration of adaptor containing fragments.
Dilute Tri-C libraries to 4 nM.
Sequence using at least 300 cycles of Illumina paired-end sequencing.
